cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.' Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.
